purpose: Reproduce observed requirements gaps, not pass/fail claims of stakeholder satisfaction.

observations.observed: An unverified lock record can be removed, released, and closed.
Stored first-good-part time can precede lock removal and release.
A stop after resumed production is absorbed into the not-yet-closed event; clock stays stopped.
A current-shift note erases the overdue handover state without an acknowledgment.
Repair is labeled as having run a full shift although another ongoing stop covers that shift.
observations.label: Verified – ran full Day shift

observations.observed: Gates evaluate recorded/applied locks only, without a job-level required-source applicability decision.
